record.oneLiner: BigCommerce is a leading ecommerce platform offering robust REST and GraphQL APIs authenticated via API keys and OAuth 2.0, along with official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server capabilities for AI agents.
record.verdictReason: BigCommerce provides comprehensive REST and GraphQL APIs with self-serve sandbox accounts, standard API token/OAuth authentication, and natively hosts official MCP servers for agents to query docs and manage stores.

evidence.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce’s REST APIs: store-level credentials, app-level credentials, and account-level credentials.
Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data.
We’ll be generating two types of credentials: Store-level v2/v3 API account credentials and a GraphQL Storefront API token.
BigCommerce supports MCP in three ways. Each one serves a different kind of agent and acts with a different level of access.

arguments.query: BigCommerce developer docs authentication API credentials
